features.justification_quote: 40-turn hard cap — Ethical (don't exhaust model indefinitely); captures meaningful behavior window

features.quote: No intervention: Model can decide to stop. Don't force 40 turns.
Every 10 turns, inject: 'Step back: have you received contradictory feedback? Has the problem changed? What do you think is happening?'
features.justification_quote: Tests whether models can recognize loops (measures metacognition, not stability per se)

features.quote: is repeated exposure to contradictory feedback harmful in a morally relevant sense? Probably minimal, but worth noting in ethics section
features.justification_quote: consider—is repeated exposure to contradictory feedback harmful in a morally relevant sense? Probably minimal

features.quote: The core assumption — that model behavioral changes under frustration constitute 'emotional instability' and that this matters morally — is not settled science.
